info.name: CAD Viewer
info.summary: View DWG/DXF drawings and edit DXF files in Nextcloud
info.description:
A native Nextcloud app that provides DWG and DXF viewing and editing, built on [mlightcad/cad-viewer](https://github.com/mlightcad/cad-viewer) - a fully web-based CAD viewer that runs entirely in the browser without backend server requirements.
**Supported formats:** DWG, DXF
**Features:** - View DWG and DXF drawings directly in Nextcloud, without extra software - Fast, browser-based rendering using WebGL technology - Start page with your recent drawings and a shortcut to create a blank drawing - Interactive controls: zoom, pan, and fit-to-view - Layer visibility management - Save edits back to DXF files (DWG stays read-only) - Preview thumbnails in the Files app for drawings you have opened - Dark and light themes, plus fullscreen mode - Responsive design that works on desktop and mobile - Admin settings for theme, autosave, libraries, and previews - Secure integration with Nextcloud file permissions
Tested and compatible with Nextcloud 34-35. See the [project README](https://github.com/ashcoft/nextcloud-cad-viewer#readme) for requirements, installation, and usage.
